visual_review: French bulldog head as one outline mirrored about x=24: flat head top, big pointed bat ears whose outer edges bulge down to the edges and tuck in at the ear base, bulging cheeks and two jowl lobes meeting at a centre cusp with a short nose line, following the reference silhouette. No Lucide match; symmetric cubic construction.
omissions: None beyond simplifying the ear tips to points.
